q: Sullivan's No Wandering Domains theorem proves that rational maps have no wandering Fatou components. The main tool was:
opts: Quasiconformal mappings and the measurable Riemann mapping theorem
exp: Sullivan (1985) used quasiconformal deformation theory: if a wandering domain existed, one could construct an infinite-dimensional family of quasiconformally conjugate maps, contradicting the finite-dimensionality of the space of rational maps.
